name: Chicken Grape Salad
description: A refreshing salad made with cooked chicken, green grapes, celery, and toasted almonds, mixed with a creamy dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine dressing ingredients in a bowl.
Toss chicken, grapes, celery, and almonds together.
Serve the chicken mixture on lettuce and garnish with parsley.

keywords: chicken salad, grape salad, creamy dressing

_similar.name: Lemon Chicken With Thyme
_similar.description: A flavorful chicken dish made with lemon juice, thyme, and a light flour coating, served with lemon wedges and parsley.
recipeIngredient: Lemon halves and chopped parsley for garnish (optional)

recipeInstructions.text: In a plastic bag, combine flour, salt, and pepper. Add chicken and shake to coat lightly.
In a large skillet, warm oil over medium heat. Brown chicken about 5 minutes each side. Transfer to a plate.
Coarsely chop the onion. Add margarine to the skillet and stir until softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in reserved flour and combine. Add chicken broth, lemon juice, and thyme. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Return chicken to skillet, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover. Cook until chicken is tender, about 5 minutes.
Serve with lemon wedges and a sprinkling of parsley, if desired.

_similar.name: Romaine Salad with Orange
_similar.description: A refreshing salad featuring romaine lettuce, oranges, and red onion with a light vinaigrette dressing.
recipeIngredient: ¼ cup red wine vinegar or cider vinegar

recipeInstructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the torn romaine lettuce, drained mandarin oranges, and thinly sliced red onion.
In a separate bowl, combine the red wine vinegar, oil, minced parsley, garlic, salt, and pepper to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: romaine salad, orange salad, vinaigrette dressing

_similar.name: Club Salad
_similar.description: A layered salad featuring romaine lettuce, bacon, eggs, cheese, chicken, carrots, and tomatoes, topped with ranch dressing or dip.
recipeIngredient: ¾ cup ranch or dip dressing
¾ cup grated cheese (marble, cheddar, etc.)

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl, layering each ingredient to look festive.

_similar.keywords: layered salad, club salad, ranch dressing

_similar.name: Caribbean Chicken Salad
_similar.description: A refreshing salad featuring chicken, mango, pineapple, and Minute Rice, all tossed in Italian dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 small can pineapple, diced and drained

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the Minute Rice in chicken broth according to package instructions.
Cook the chicken breast meat in a little oil until fully cooked.
Combine the cooked rice, chicken, and remaining ingredients in a large bowl.
Chill until served. Optional: add other fruits like grapes, mandarins, or plums for variation.

_similar.keywords: Caribbean chicken salad, fruit and rice salad, Italian dressing

_similar.name: Onion Salad
_similar.description: A simple onion salad marinated in a sweet and tangy dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Marinate the thinly sliced onions with salt, sugar, water, and vinegar overnight.
Drain the marinade well in the morning.
Add mayonnaise (or salad dressing) and celery seed to the drained onions.
Chill until ready to serve.

_similar.keywords: onion salad, marinated onions, sweet and tangy salad
